name: app-oviah-how-might-we-question-cards-row
title: OVIAH 'How Might We?' ideation slide: five lilac question cards alternating in shade
whatItIs: A simple white slide with a bold 'How Might We?' heading and five rounded cards in alternating light and mid lilac, each posing one design question ('How might we help women better understand and manage their menstrual health?', 'How might we simplify health information?').
whatItMeans: Focused and generative; alternating card shades keeps five similar questions visually distinct and scannable.
techniques: Alternate two tints across a row of similar cards.
Phrase each card as an open 'How might we' question.
Keep card copy short enough to read at a glance.

vocabulary.definition: A design-thinking technique for reframing problems as questions.
Switching between light and darker shades of one colour.
